## Outcome

A11Y-2 is implemented and verified. The shell now owns a route-wide keyboard shortcut listener, the non-spatial path works without the canvas, Settings documents every shortcut, and the board exposes a named/described canvas region plus a visible `Open card list` action.

### Acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Keyboard journey: create, edit, provenance attach, association create/retype, search, recall enter/check/reset/exit | **Pass** — `e2e/keyboard-journey.spec.ts`, 3/3 projects |
| `AppShell` mounts `KeyboardShortcuts` on every route | **Pass** — mounted in `AppShell.tsx`; component test opens help from the shell |
| Every shortcut listed in Settings; shortcuts suppressed while typing | **Pass** — one shared `KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS` list drives Settings and help; guard test covers input, textarea, select, contenteditable. `Escape` remains active by the feature’s documented `Always` guard so it can clear search/close overlays |
| Focus visible, logical, restored after dialogs/sheets | **Pass** — help, edit, connection picker, nested manage dialog, delete confirmation, undo, and recall reset assertions |
| Canvas name, description, and visible `Open card list` | **Pass** — host `role="group"` named `Case board canvas`, dynamic description with card count and card-list alternative, visible link asserted in browser |
| No keyboard trap on primary screens | **Pass** — no new trap; existing `Dialog` traps only while open and closes on Escape; recall reset moves focus to `Check` instead of losing it to body |

### Keyboard path / viewports exercised

- **Browser:** Chromium, keyboard-only interactions (`focus()` + Enter/Space/typing, native file input), no pointer gestures.
- **Desktop:** 1440x900 — **Pass**
- **Tablet landscape:** 1280x800 — **Pass**
- **Phone:** 390x844 — **Pass** (search opens from `/`; recall entry uses the Case actions sheet)
- **Component:** jsdom focus, shortcut-guard, Settings documentation, canvas description, and recall focus tests.

### Accessibility evidence

- **Focus restoration:** `?` returns to the invoking control; card edit returns to Edit; picker returns to Connect/Attach source; nested connection dialog returns to its trigger; delete/undo return to the relevant card action; Reset recall lands on Check.
- **Announcements:** existing SearchPanel result status, recall live region, and Toast regions are exercised; no new focus-moving live regions.
- **Targets/contrast:** new controls use existing `Button`/`IconButton` 44px primitives and semantic tokens only; no raw palette values in changed component files.
- **Motion:** no new animation; existing reduced-motion rules remain intact.
- **Text safety:** all new content is plain React text; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

### Validation run

- `npm test -- tests/a11y/keyboard.test.tsx` — **pass** (12 tests)
- `npm run test:e2e -- e2e/keyboard-journey.spec.ts` — **pass** (3 projects)
- `npm run typecheck` — **pass**
- `npm run lint` — **pass**, 0 errors; 3 pre-existing `react-refresh` warnings in `RecallSummary.tsx`
- `npm run format:check` — **pass**
- `npm test` — **pass**, 81 files / 1019 tests
- `npm run build` (run by Playwright) — **pass**

### Files created

- `src/app/KeyboardShortcuts.tsx`
- `src/app/focus.ts`
- `src/components/ShortcutList.tsx`
- `src/components/shortcuts.ts`
- `tests/a11y/keyboard.test.tsx`
- `e2e/keyboard-journey.spec.ts`

### Files changed

- `src/app/AppShell.tsx`
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.tsx`
- `src/components/components.css`
- `src/features/cards/CardDetailPage.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CardListPanel.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`
- `src/features/recall/RecallToolbar.tsx`
- `src/features/search/SearchPanel.tsx`
- `src/features/settings/SettingsPage.tsx`

### Shared-file handoff notes

- `AppShell.tsx`: keep `<KeyboardShortcuts />` mounted inside the router shell so shortcuts remain route-wide.
- `CaseBoardPage.tsx`: the new `FOCUS_SEARCH_EVENT` listener is what opens the phone search sheet from `/`; preserve it when changing phone sheet state.
- `BoardCanvas.tsx`: the host now owns `aria-describedby` and `data-testid="open-card-list"` is on the visible link. The generated Pixi canvas keeps its existing `role="img"`/label; the wrapper is the named, described region.
- `SearchPanel.tsx`: keep `data-shortcut-target="search"` on the input and the `?focus=search` mount focus behavior.
- `CardListPanel.tsx`: `data-card-row`, `data-card-open`, and `data-connect-action` drive `[/]` and `c`; preserve them.
- `SettingsPage.tsx`: render `ShortcutList` so the Settings list stays in sync with the shared definitions.

### Known limitations

- Spatial placement, canvas panning, and scratch drawing remain pointer-only by design.
- Playwright evidence is Chromium-only; Firefox/WebKit smoke remains A11Y-6 scope.
- `docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` and `docs/WORKFLOW-STATE.json` contain pre-existing engine modifications and were not touched.

handoff.summary: Implemented A11Y-2: route-wide KeyboardShortcuts and focus helpers mounted in AppShell, keyboard wiring for card CRUD, provenance attach, connection create/retype, search, recall check/reset/exit, Settings shortcut documentation, and a named/described canvas with a visible Open card list action. Unit suite, keyboard component tests, keyboard-only Playwright journey at desktop/tablet/phone, typecheck, lint, formatting, and build pass.
decisions: Used one shared KEYBOARD_SHORTCUTS definition for both the ? help dialog and the Settings reference so they cannot drift.
Suppressed ?, /, [, ], and c for editable targets; kept Escape active per the feature's Always guard so it can close overlays or clear search.
Used DOM focus as the source of truth: [ and ] move to the previous/next [data-card-row], while c focuses and clicks that row's real Connect button so the dialog restores focus to it.
Kept the Pixi canvas element's existing role/label and added the accessible description to the surrounding host group, avoiding a second renderer concern in the board component.
On card detail and capture, / dispatches the search event and falls back to navigating to the case card list with ?focus=search; the card list panel focuses its field on mount.
Reset recall moves focus to Check when Reset disables itself, preventing focus from falling to the document body.
interfaces: KeyboardShortcuts({ enabled? }) mounted by AppShell; ShortcutList shared by Settings and the help dialog.
focus.ts exports FOCUS_SEARCH_EVENT, DISMISS_EVENT, isEditableElement, hasOpenDialog, activeFocusElement, focusMainLandmark, focusSearchField, moveCardListFocus, and connectFocusedCard.
SearchPanel input exposes data-shortcut-target=search and accepts ?focus=search on mount.
CardListPanel rows expose data-card-row, data-card-open, and data-connect-action.
BoardCanvas host exposes aria-label='Case board canvas' plus the dynamic card-count description, and the visible link has data-testid=open-card-list.
RecallToolbar actions expose data-recall-action values and recover focus after Reset becomes disabled.
tests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/keyboard-journey.spec.ts: exit 0 (3 passed at desktop 1440x900, tablet 1280x800, phone 390x844)
npm run lint: exit 0 with 3 pre-existing RecallSummary warnings
warnings: Playwright evidence covers Chromium-based projects only.
Escape intentionally remains active while typing so it can clear an active search; letter, bracket, slash, and c shortcuts stay inert.
The generated Pixi canvas keeps its existing aria-label; the named and described region is the canvas host wrapper.
validationLimitations: Spatial placement, panning, and scratch drawing were not exercised by keyboard because they remain pointer-only by design.
Headless Chromium cannot validate safe-area or visual focus-ring appearance; those remain human visual review items.
